snippet.title: How to Use Aimlabs in 2026 | Official Beginner's Guide (PC & Console)
snippet.description:
Want to improve your aim and dominate in FPS games? This is the official 2026 Aimlabs tutorial that shows you exactly how to train smarter, track your progress, and level up your gameplay. Whether you're grinding VALORANT, CS2, or any competitive shooter, this complete guide has everything you need.

Welcome to the complete 2026 Aimlabs guide! Whether you're on PC, Xbox, or PlayStation, this tutorial covers everything you need to master your aim training, from essential settings and navigation to powerful features most players don't even know exist.

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS
0:00 - Intro & Welcome
0:18 - PC Home Screen Navigation
0:25 - Gridshot & Search Bar
0:40 - Console Home Screen
0:57 - Starting Your First Task
1:23 - Task Descriptions & Icons
1:41 - Settings Overview
1:58 - Sensitivity & Game Profiles
2:17 - Mouse/Controller Settings
2:35 - Crosshair Customization
2:47 - Target Appearance
2:48 - Audio Settings & Custom Sounds
3:21 - Graphics & Visuals
3:37 - Visuals Presets & Theme Codes
3:41 - Game Tab Settings
3:54 - Skins Tab
4:02 - Results Page Breakdown
4:28 - Replay Tab & VOD Review
4:31 - Leading/Trailing Paths
4:45 - Compare with Top Players
5:09 - Daily Streak System
5:22 - Training Library (PC)
6:14 - Training Library (Console)
6:38 - Pinning & Favorites
6:55 - Benchmarks (Ranked Mode)
7:17 - Outro

This guide walks you through Aimlabs settings, how to match your in-game sensitivity, custom crosshairs, detailed analytics, and the replay comparison tool that lets you study exactly what top aimers do differently. Master flicking, tracking, speed, precision and more!

Aimlabs is the FREE aim trainer trusted by over 40 million players worldwide to dominate in VALORANT, CS2, Fortnite, Apex Legends, Call of Duty, and every FPS game.
